units.source_text: [\[10\]](#part1336.html#w10) 筝形似七弦琴，但有十三弦。

en.t: The zheng resembles a seven-stringed qin, but it has thirteen strings.

units.source_text: 最靠近弹者的三根，即第十一、十二、十三弦，都是细弦，称为“斗”“为”“巾”。

en.t: The three strings closest to the player, namely the eleventh, twelfth, and thirteenth strings, are all thin strings and are called "dou," "wei," and "jin."

units.source_text: 中央一根细弦，是指“为”弦。

en.t: The thin string in the middle refers to the "wei" string.
